name: FRAGCOORD
doc: Coordinate of pixel center. In screen space. xy specifies position in viewport. Upper-left of the viewport is the origin, (0.0, 0.0).

name: COLOR
doc: Input color. This is the output of the fragment() function.

name: UV
doc: UV from the vertex() function, equivalent to the UV in the fragment() function.

name: TEXTURE
doc: Current texture in use for CanvasItem.

name: TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE
doc: Normalized pixel size of TEXTURE. For a Sprite2D with a TEXTURE of size 64x32 pixels, TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE = vec2(1/64, 1/32)

name: SCREEN_UV
doc: Screen UV coordinate for current pixel.

name: LIGHT_COLOR
doc: Color of the Light2D. If the light is a PointLight2D, multiplied by the light's texture.

name: LIGHT_POSITION
doc: Position of the Light2D in screen space. If using a DirectionalLight2D this is always (0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

name: LIGHT_DIRECTION
doc: Direction of the Light2D in screen space.

name: LIGHT_IS_DIRECTIONAL
doc: true if this pass is a DirectionalLight2D.

name: LIGHT_VERTEX
doc: Pixel position, in screen space as modified in the fragment() function.

name: SPECULAR_SHININESS
doc: Specular shininess, as set in the object's texture.

name: SHADOW_MODULATE
doc: Multiply shadows cast at this point by this color.
